Npc115753 is linked to a dual serine/threonine and tyrosine protein kinase, which is a target of multiple compounds, including Javanicoside F and Corticatic Acid E. These compounds both direct their activity to SMMC-7721, a cell line that may be affected by these targets. The evidence is consistent across three paths, with similar target relationships, indicating a possible mechanism of action involving this kinase. The presence of multiple compounds targeting the same kinase suggests a potential role in the regulation of SMMC-7721, possibly through the modulation of cellular processes. The integration of these pathways highlights the kinase as a central node in the interaction network, with Npc115753 potentially influencing SMMC-7721 through this target. The evidence supports a mechanism where Npc115753 may act as a modulator of the kinase, which in turn affects SMMC-7721, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
